children.name:
Organize software work as projects with optional teams and durable
      workstreams, give every scope one conversation, and expose an
      evidence-oriented work view without introducing sprint mechanics.
terms:
"
      Organize software work as projects with optional teams and durable
      workstreams, give every scope one conversation, and expose an
      evidence-oriented work view without introducing sprint mechanics.
      "
"Keep discussion, formal definition, implementation, delivery, and production follow-up under one durable workstream identity."
"The reason for a change and the evidence of its effect must survive tool and lifecycle transitions."
"Do not treat a ticket, chat room, branch, deployment, or alert as the sole container for the work."
"Allow a workstream to belong directly to a project or to one team in that project."
"Small projects need no artificial team hierarchy while larger projects still need ownership boundaries."
"Do not require a sprint, board, or team merely to open and discuss work."

children.name: Every project, team, and workstream has exactly one durable conversation provisioned with the same access boundary as its scope.
terms: "Every project, team, and workstream has exactly one durable conversation provisioned with the same access boundary as its scope."

children.name: A team belongs to exactly one active project; its participants are active members of that project.
terms: "A team belongs to exactly one active project; its participants are active members of that project."

children.name: A workstream belongs to exactly one project and either no team or one active team from that same project.
terms: "A workstream belongs to exactly one project and either no team or one active team from that same project."

children.name: A workstream may be opened directly below a project; team placement is optional and can change without changing workstream or conversation identity.
terms: "A workstream may be opened directly below a project; team placement is optional and can change without changing workstream or conversation identity."

children.name: Project removal or membership revocation removes future access to descendant team and workstream conversations without deleting retained attributable history.
terms: "Project removal or membership revocation removes future access to descendant team and workstream conversations without deleting retained attributable history."

children.name: Participant synchronization never grants a team or workstream participant access beyond their current project membership.
terms: "Participant synchronization never grants a team or workstream participant access beyond their current project membership."

children.name: Workstream kind describes the source of work and never selects a fixed delivery process.
terms: "Workstream kind describes the source of work and never selects a fixed delivery process."

children.name: ReadyForImplementation requires a current reviewed ticket definition, no blocking open question, satisfied declared dependencies, and every policy-required formal review.
terms: "ReadyForImplementation requires a current reviewed ticket definition, no blocking open question, satisfied declared dependencies, and every policy-required formal review."

children.name: Done requires the evidence selected by project policy; a code merge alone never proves completion.
terms: "Done requires the evidence selected by project policy; a code merge alone never proves completion."

children.name: Blocked retains the previous stage, blocker reason, and supporting evidence so unblocking can resume deliberately.
terms: "Blocked retains the previous stage, blocker reason, and supporting evidence so unblocking can resume deliberately."

children.name: Boards sort and filter workstreams by evidence-backed stage, kind, priority projection, ownership, activity, and production health without introducing Sprint or StoryPoint concepts.
terms: "Boards sort and filter workstreams by evidence-backed stage, kind, priority projection, ownership, activity, and production health without introducing Sprint or StoryPoint concepts."

children.name: Archiving a scope prevents new work and messages but retains its conversations, tickets, run history, artifacts, and audit relations.
terms: "Archiving a scope prevents new work and messages but retains its conversations, tickets, run history, artifacts, and audit relations."
